text: The authors contest the prevailing scholarly proposition that harmonized conflict of laws principles are necessary to govern digital assets across common and civil law jurisdictions, arguing that this proposition misconstrues the foundational ethos of blockchain technology.
citation: Furrer Andreas, Wulf A. Kaal, Universal Digital Law Codex (UDLC) Building the Legal Infrastructure for the Digital Era (2025). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=5554218

isBasedOn.name: Universal Digital Law Codex (UDLC) Building the Legal Infrastructure for the Digital Era

abstract: The proposition that harmonized conflict of laws principles are necessary to govern digital assets across common law and civil law jurisdictions, as advocated by scholars like Aleinieh, Zoboli, Atiyah, and Kasatkina, misconstrues the foundational ethos of blockchain technology

value: proposals advanced by Aleinieh, Zoboli, Atiyah, and Kasatkina
